strategyReview: The WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG signal remains the standout performer with a 74% win rate and +0.89 total PnL across 181 live trades, while ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO has a perfect 4/4 live track record and strong shadow PnL, supporting further promotion. FUNDING_EXTREME_SHORT works well on AMZN (79%) but poorly on OIL (38%), and FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG continues to underperform (47% win, negative PnL) especially on AMZN and HYPE, which are correctly disabled. LLM_HYPOTHESIS and NO_BIAS_ADJUSTED_GAP_SHADOW are consistent loss generators with net negative PnL, while the ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO shadows on BTC suffer from wide spreads and edge decay. PC_RATIO_EXTREME signals are modestly positive overall but asset-specific; PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW on AMZN is a disaster (20% win).

failureClusters.theme: Funding Extreme Long Decay on AMZN/HYPE
failureClusters.evidence: Live FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG on AMZN has 29% win rate and -$0.11, on HYPE 33% and -$0.10; stops dominate. Shadow signals also underperform (FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG shadows 60% win but only +0.01).
failureClusters.recommendation: Keep AMZN and HYPE disabled for FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG; do not reactivate until clean signals emerge. Consider permanent exclusion for these assets in this signal family.

failureClusters.evidence: NO_BIAS_ADJUSTED_GAP_SHADOW has 42% win rate (37/89) and -1.16 net PnL across all assets, with heavy losses on BTC and GOLD. Recent resolved shadows show consistent gaps that collapse unfavorably.
failureClusters.recommendation: Keep this signal in shadow-only mode with no live promotion. Consider adding a stricter edge size filter or only triggering when spreads are tight.

failureClusters.theme: One-Touch NO Edge Collapse on BTC
failureClusters.evidence: Three recent resolved ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO shadows on BTC resulted in losses of -0.1%, -5.56%, and -1.25%, often with wide spreads and moderate edge (1–2pts). Overall shadow win rate 42.5% despite positive average PnL.
failureClusters.recommendation: Require a higher minimum sell-YES edge (>2 pts) and tighter spread (<0.01) for BTC one-touch NO shadows. Monitor open quality warnings for spread widening.

hypothesisReviews.observation: H-534 (ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO on GOLD heatmap) has 20% win rate over 20 tests, likely due to wide spreads and edge collapse. The heatmap cluster's historical performance (+0.649 over 12 shadows) may not replicate in the current regime. Continue shadow testing but enforce a higher minimum edge (≥3 pts) and tighter spread.

H-523 (BTC PM IV regime-relative compression) shows 50% win rate over 11 tests, borderline. The last few tests were losses, suggesting IV compression alone is insufficient. Consider adding a confirmation condition such as btc_hl_funding_ann > 0 to filter for funding tailwinds.

journalEntry: Weekend funding reversion remains the backbone of profitability; further asset extensions like MU are worth formal shadow tests. The ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO live signal has perfect record, but GOLD shadow performance is mixed, requiring stricter edge filtering. The no-bias adjusted gap shadow continues to bleed and should stay in shadow only. PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW on AMZN is too unreliable; keep it disabled. No parameter adjustments at this time.
